title: British Columbia Place early-1980s geometric reconstruction

bc-place-ltd.notes: Corporate b/c/p identity documented in a 22 September 1982 advertisement and the 19 June 1983 opening programme. The collected 1983 annual-report crop is retained; separately labelled geometric SVG reconstructions add editable artwork. Designer, exact first/last use and production colours remain unconfirmed.

assets.label: British Columbia Place — Full signature — scan-informed blue and black reconstruction
assets.publisher: PofBC project reconstruction; historical specimens published by British Columbia Place Ltd.
assets.sourceLocator: PDF page 4; programme cover dates the gala to 19 June 1983
assets.dateNote: Dated uses, not a verified adoption or retirement date. The filename uses the earliest confirmed specimen year. Reconstruction made 2026-11-03.
assets.notes: Clean vector reconstruction of the corporate b/c/p monogram and staggered lowercase wordmark. Custom outlined lettering retains the open b/p/a joins, angled c, diagonal e and shared h/l alignment. Checked against the 1983 opening programme and the collected annual-report scan; the same identity is visible in a 22 September 1982 advertisement. Blue #0096d6 is sampled from the colour-managed museum scan, not an authenticated production colour.
assets.fidelityNote: Modern geometric redraw, not a recovered original vector master. Source compared with an explicit pixel overlay; scan noise and printing irregularities are not reproduced. Original designer, exact historical typeface and production colour specification remain unconfirmed.
assets.creator: PofBC project, 2026-11-03; original designer unconfirmed

verification.construction: Explicit hand-authored arcs, circles and letterform paths; no tracing or embedded font
